lead.tldr: Morgan Stanley files for bank charter to custody crypto and enable staking, accelerating institutional infrastructure buildout. • Tether freezes $4.2B USDT tied to crime over three years, bolstering compliance credentials for stablecoin dominance. • Crypto startups raise $883M in February, with VCs targeting stablecoins, AI agents, and institutional tools amid tighter discipline. • US DOJ seizes $580M from Chinese criminals, signaling intensified enforcement and potential victim restitution flows. • South Korea tax office leaks seed phrase, resulting in $4.8M token theft and exposing custody vulnerabilities. • US-Israel strikes on Iran push Bitcoin toward $63K, averting liquidation cascade despite macro volatility risks.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, Morgan Stanley advances institutional crypto adoption with a bank charter for custody and staking. Paradigm diversifies into AI and robotics via a $1.5B fund, while VCs target stablecoins and institutional tools amid $883M in February raises. Tether's $4.2B USDT freezes underscore compliance efforts.

top_signals.title: U.S. and Israel launch airstrikes against Iran after enormous military build-up in the Mideast, risking wider regional conflict
top_signals.summary: On February 28, 2026, the United States and Israel launched coordinated airstrikes under operations codenamed Roaring Lion, Operation Shield of Judah, and Operation Epic Fury, targeting Iranian cities including Tehran, Isfahan, Qom, Karaj, Kermanshah, and Bushehr to destroy missile capabilities, prevent nuclear weapon development, and weaken the regime. President Donald Trump announced the strikes alongside Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who described them as essential to eliminate Iran's existential threat after decades of hostility, while calling on IRGC members to surrender. The attacks killed or wounded thousands of IRGC personnel and hit key military sites, following prior U.S. strikes on Iranian nuclear facilities in June, amid Iran's missile retaliation alerts. For institutional investors, this escalation heightens risks to oil prices, supply chains through the Strait of Hormuz, and global energy markets, potentially amplifying volatility in commodities and defense sectors.

top_signals.title: Morgan Stanley doubles down on crypto, files for bank charter to custody digital assets and offer staking: Bloomberg
top_signals.summary: Morgan Stanley has filed for a national trust bank charter to custody digital assets and offer staking services. This move signals increased institutional adoption and regulatory engagement in the crypto space.

top_signals.title: Paradigm Reportedly Expands into AI, Robotics with $1.5B fund
top_signals.summary: Paradigm, a crypto VC firm, is reportedly raising a $1.5 billion fund to invest in AI, robotics, and other frontier technologies, while continuing its investments in the crypto space. This expansion indicates a diversification of investment strategy into emerging technology sectors.

top_signals.title: Tether Freezes $4.2B in USDT Linked to Crime in 3 Years: Report
top_signals.summary: Tether has frozen $4.2 billion in USDT over the last three years to assist law enforcement in combating fraud, money laundering, and illegal betting. This action highlights Tether's efforts to comply with regulatory requests and combat illicit activities within the cryptocurrency space.

top_signals.title: South Korea Tax Office Leaks Seed Phrase in Press Release
top_signals.summary: South Korea's National Tax Service inadvertently leaked a wallet seed phrase in a press release, leading to the theft of 4 million PRTG tokens valued at $4.8 million. The incident highlights significant security risks associated with handling crypto assets.

top_signals.title: South Korea tax service reveals crypto wallet recovery phrase in press release, seized tokens moved in suspected breach: report
top_signals.summary: The South Korean tax service inadvertently revealed a crypto wallet recovery phrase in a press release, leading to a suspected breach and movement of seized tokens. This incident adds to a series of crypto custody failures involving South Korean authorities.

top_signals.title: US DOJ Seized $580M in Crypto from ‘Chinese Transnational Criminals‘
top_signals.summary: The US Department of Justice seized $580 million in cryptocurrency from alleged Chinese transnational criminals. The DOJ intends to forfeit the funds and return them to the victims.

top_signals.title: VC ‘spray-and-pray era over’ as crypto startups raise $883m in February
top_signals.summary: Crypto startups raised $883 million in February, indicating fundraising is down but not out. Stablecoins, AI agents, and institutional tools are the top sectors for VC interest.

top_signals.title: Aave Labs leads in major vote after backtracking on plan to sideline v3
top_signals.summary: Aave DAO is voting on a proposal to send up to $42 million to Aave Labs. The vote is closely contested, with one side holding a narrow advantage.

top_signals.title: The week the AI scare turned real and America realized maybe it isn’t ready for what’s coming
top_signals.summary: The article discusses the increasing impact of AI on the economy, highlighting concerns such as 'Ghost GDP' and mass layoffs in tech companies. It suggests that America may not be fully prepared for the changes brought about by AI.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin’s March volatility looms: Is BTC facing another bull trap?
top_signals.summary: The article discusses potential volatility for Bitcoin in March, suggesting a possible Q1 slump due to macro FUD and capital rotation. It raises concerns about a potential bull trap for BTC.

top_signals.title: US, Israel Move on Iran Forces Bitcoin Toward $63,000
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin's price reacted to a fresh attack on Iran, moving towards $63,000. The price action avoided a significant liquidation cascade.

linkedin_post: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, The crypto ecosystem is maturing fast, and this week delivered powerful proof points. At Blockwall, we track these signals closely as we back the next generation of pre-seed and seed founders building the decentralized future. Morgan Stanley filed for a national trust bank charter to custody digital assets and offer staking services. This is a watershed moment: one of the world's largest financial institutions is building dedicated crypto infrastructure from the ground up. For our portfolio companies and the broader ecosystem, this signals that institutional demand for regulated digital asset services is no longer speculative, it is operational. Meanwhile, Paradigm raised a $1.5 billion fund spanning crypto, AI, and robotics. This move underscores a broader thesis we share: the convergence of blockchain infrastructure with artificial intelligence will define the next decade of innovation. As AI agents increasingly interact with on-chain systems, the demand for secure, scalable infrastructure only grows. On the security front, Tether revealed it has frozen $4.2 billion in USDT tied to illicit activity over the past three years. This level of proactive compliance demonstrates that stablecoin issuers are stepping up to meet institutional expectations and regulatory standards. These developments reinforce why Blockwall remains committed to backing visionary teams at the intersection of crypto, compliance, and emerging tech with disciplined, long-term conviction. What institutional crypto development has you most excited for what comes next? #Web3 #Crypto #Blockchain #CryptoVC
